edition: Unofficial fan-made planning set; every entry is speculative

trophies.name: State of the Art
trophies.description: Complete every other entry in this planning set.
trophies.hint: Keep a short list of unfinished categories; the last few are easier to spot when grouped.

trophies.name: Last Light on the Causeway
trophies.description: See the main story through to its final chapter.
trophies.hint: Follow the central story markers before spending time on optional errands.

trophies.name: First Day in the Heat
trophies.description: Finish the opening stretch and settle into the state.
trophies.hint: Play through the introductory sequence; no special route is needed.

trophies.name: Rooms with a View
trophies.description: Visit a safe place in each of the first three districts.
trophies.hint: Check the map for home markers as new neighborhoods open up.

trophies.name: A Favor in Transit
trophies.description: Deliver a package for a stranger without damaging it.
trophies.hint: Ease off the throttle on tight turns and avoid taking the direct route through traffic.

trophies.name: Quiet Exit
trophies.description: Leave a restricted site without raising an alarm.
trophies.hint: Watch patrol timing, use cover, and keep a second exit in mind.

trophies.name: Paper Trails
trophies.description: Complete six errands that begin with a note, message, or posting.
trophies.hint: Read the small prompts that arrive between story missions; several lead to optional work.

trophies.name: The Long Detour
trophies.description: Finish twelve optional character jobs.
trophies.hint: Return to familiar places after story chapters; people may have a new request.

trophies.name: The Local Circuit
trophies.description: Enter five different street races.
trophies.hint: Look for event markers in more than one district, not just the first race hub.

trophies.name: Three Green Lights
trophies.description: Win a race after starting from the back of the pack.
trophies.hint: Save boost for a long straight and avoid contact in the opening corners.

trophies.name: Hands on the Wheel
trophies.description: Add twelve distinct vehicles to your personal collection.
trophies.hint: Use a mix of garages and vehicle types; duplicates do not broaden a collection.

trophies.name: A Clean Getaway
trophies.description: Lose a pursuit without switching vehicles.
trophies.hint: Break the line of sight, then keep moving until the search area clears.

trophies.name: No Sirens Tonight
trophies.description: Escape a high-alert pursuit on foot.
trophies.hint: A covered alley or building entrance can help you break sight before the search tightens.

trophies.name: Sunk Costs
trophies.description: Complete a boat trip between two distant docks.
trophies.hint: Pick a calm stretch of water and stay clear of shallow channels.

trophies.name: Skyline Postcard
trophies.description: Take a picture from a high-rise lookout.
trophies.hint: Reach a public rooftop or overlook and use the in-game camera.

trophies.name: Across the Flats
trophies.description: Drive from the coast to the northern edge without using a fast-travel point.
trophies.hint: Start with a full tank and follow the main highway until the landscape changes.

trophies.name: Heat Check
trophies.description: Complete a pursuit while your vehicle is badly damaged.
trophies.hint: Keep a repair option nearby and prioritize distance over risky shortcuts.

trophies.name: After Hours
trophies.description: Visit three venues after dark.
trophies.hint: Wait for nightfall, then check the map around busy commercial blocks.

trophies.name: Backroom Regular
trophies.description: Finish a round in four different side games.
trophies.hint: Try the tables and cabinets found inside shops, lounges, and neighborhood venues.

trophies.name: Pocket Change
trophies.description: Spend money at five different kinds of business.
trophies.hint: Mix practical stops with food, clothing, and vehicle services.

trophies.name: Cash Flow
trophies.description: Earn a substantial payout from optional jobs.
trophies.hint: Chain repeatable work and collect the reward after each completed objective.

trophies.name: Small Repairs
trophies.description: Repair a vehicle at a neighborhood workshop.
trophies.hint: Pull into a marked garage with a damaged car and use its service prompt.

trophies.name: Garage Full
trophies.description: Store a different vehicle in every available personal slot.
trophies.hint: Check each owned garage for its capacity before tracking down more rides.

trophies.name: Borrowed Time
trophies.description: Escape a chase in a vehicle you found on the street.
trophies.hint: Choose something common enough to blend into traffic once the search begins.

trophies.name: Lucky Break
trophies.description: Find a useful item while exploring away from a marked activity.
trophies.hint: Check overlooked corners, service roads, and the space behind buildings.

trophies.name: All Roads Marked
trophies.description: Reveal every named region on the map.
trophies.hint: Drive or travel through the edge of each shaded area; discovering a road is not always enough.

trophies.name: Backwater Quiet
trophies.description: Photograph six different kinds of wildlife.
trophies.hint: Move slowly near marshes and wooded paths, and keep the camera ready.

trophies.name: Salt and Sand
trophies.description: Spend a full in-game afternoon along the shoreline.
trophies.hint: Stay near the coast through the changing light; a brief visit will not count.

trophies.name: Tall Grass
trophies.description: Recover eight keepsakes hidden outside city streets.
trophies.hint: Search trailheads and quiet pull-offs; listen for subtle audio cues.

trophies.name: Lost Signal
trophies.description: Reach a remote point where mobile service drops out.
trophies.hint: Follow a rough road away from settled areas until the signal indicator fades.

trophies.name: Paper Moon
trophies.description: Collect every page in one scattered notebook set.
trophies.hint: When you find a page, mark nearby search spots before leaving the area.

trophies.name: Three Stops
trophies.description: Take public transport through three different stations.
trophies.hint: Ride the full route between stops rather than leaving as soon as you board.

trophies.name: Local Color
trophies.description: Attend a community gathering in four separate towns.
trophies.hint: Explore town centers at different times of day and look for crowds or event boards.

trophies.name: The Good Neighbor
trophies.description: Help a stranded driver get back on the road.
trophies.hint: Respond to a roadside encounter and stay nearby until it is resolved.

trophies.name: Streetwise
trophies.description: Complete every optional character-job strand.
trophies.hint: Track each contact after story milestones; a finished strand may unlock another later.

trophies.name: Keep Moving
trophies.description: Travel a long distance on foot without entering a vehicle.
trophies.hint: Follow a safe pedestrian route and let the distance accumulate naturally.

trophies.name: One More Take
trophies.description: Retry a stunt and improve your previous result.
trophies.hint: Use the same approach, then change one part of your speed or launch angle.

trophies.name: Smooth Landing
trophies.description: Land an aircraft on a short strip without damaging it.
trophies.hint: Reduce speed early, line up with the runway, and avoid sharp corrections near touchdown.

trophies.name: Off the Grid
trophies.description: Spend a night camping far from a paved road.
trophies.hint: Find an open patch in the countryside and use the rest interaction after dark.

trophies.name: State of the Plate
trophies.description: Sample a signature meal in five regions.
trophies.hint: Look for small local counters away from the busiest tourist strips.

trophies.name: No Loose Ends
trophies.description: Finish every listed activity in one district.
trophies.hint: Use the map legend to compare icons against the district activity list.

trophies.name: Full Tank, Empty Map
trophies.description: Drive every marked road in a single county.
trophies.hint: Zoom in and trace unvisited branches, including roads that end at water or fields.

trophies.name: A Little Side Hustle
trophies.description: Complete a delivery, a recovery, and a timed errand.
trophies.hint: Vary the kind of optional work you accept instead of repeating one job.

trophies.name: The View from Here
trophies.description: Reach the highest natural overlook in the state.
trophies.hint: Look for switchbacks and a trail marker where the northern road begins to climb.

trophies.name: Nothing but Net
trophies.description: Score from beyond the marked line in a street-court game.
trophies.hint: Take time to learn the shot timing before attempting a long-range score.

trophies.name: All Washed Up
trophies.description: Clean a dusty vehicle at a self-service wash.
trophies.hint: Use a wash station after a long country drive; a spotless car may not trigger it.

trophies.name: Night Shift
trophies.description: Complete three activities that begin after midnight.
trophies.hint: Check your watch and revisit venues or job contacts during late hours.

trophies.name: No Wake
trophies.description: Cross a quiet inlet by boat without hitting another vessel.
trophies.hint: Ease the throttle around docks and let other boats pass before turning.

trophies.name: Hands Clean
trophies.description: Finish a marked objective without harming a bystander.
trophies.hint: Keep your aim low and use controlled movement when a crowd is nearby.

trophies.name: Change of Plans
trophies.description: Switch to a different route after receiving a new objective.
trophies.hint: When the map updates, follow the alternate marker rather than your first waypoint.

trophies.name: Coast to Coast
trophies.description: Complete a journey through every major landscape region.
trophies.hint: Plan a route that includes shoreline, city, wetlands, and inland roads.

trophies.name: A Good Listener
trophies.description: Hear every optional conversation during one safe ride.
trophies.hint: Let the drive continue without skipping ahead or changing vehicles.

trophies.name: Street Market
trophies.description: Visit a vendor in every market district.
trophies.hint: Browse stalls at different times; some neighborhoods wake up after sunset.

trophies.name: The Scenic Route
trophies.description: Reach a destination using only roads marked as scenic.
trophies.hint: Set a waypoint, then favor the narrow coastal and country roads over the highway.

trophies.name: Made to Measure
trophies.description: Customize a vehicle in four separate categories.
trophies.hint: Change more than paint: visit a workshop for mechanical and visual options.

trophies.name: Early Checkout
trophies.description: Leave a hotel before sunrise after checking in the night before.
trophies.hint: Use a lodging interaction after dark, then return when the sky is still dim.

trophies.name: A Map of My Own
trophies.description: Place a personal marker in ten different regions.
trophies.hint: Keep one marker per region and move it only after the count registers.

trophies.name: Two Wheels, No Worries
trophies.description: Complete a long ride on a bicycle without falling.
trophies.hint: Stay on flatter roads and brake gently before corners.

trophies.name: Open Water
trophies.description: Reach a distant island and return to the mainland.
trophies.hint: Choose a seaworthy ride and note the return crossing before setting out.

trophies.name: Keep the Receipt
trophies.description: Buy an item in a shop, then sell a different item later.
trophies.hint: Use any two businesses that support purchases or trade-ins.

trophies.name: No Shortcuts
trophies.description: Complete a timed challenge without using a marked fast route.
trophies.hint: Study the course once, then take the clean line instead of cutting through obstacles.

trophies.name: Small-Town Hours
trophies.description: Spend time in a rural town from morning until evening.
trophies.hint: Stay in the same town as the in-game clock moves across the day.

trophies.name: Every Mile Counts
trophies.description: Complete the story, optional work, and exploration milestones in this guide.
trophies.hint: Compare your progress by category and finish the smallest remaining group first.

trophies.name: The State Stays With You
trophies.description: Return to a favorite region after completing the main story.
trophies.hint: After the finale, revisit any named area and spend a little time there.
